slices.title: Fix OHDER analyzer path normalization
slices.description: Remove analyzer path truncation defects before stricter OHDER enforcement depends on analyzer output.
acceptanceCriteria: Analyzer output preserves ask-core relative paths without truncation.
Analyzer findings use normalized slash paths.
Existing analyzer contracts remain green.

slices.title: Add OHDER runtime modes
slices.description: Implement fast, strict, and refactor as policy-driven OHDER governance modes.
acceptanceCriteria: Policy supports ohder.mode fast, strict, and refactor.
Architect status exposes the selected mode.
Strict mode can block hard analyzer findings.
Fast mode preserves warning-first behavior.

slices.title: Expand OHDER hard-law coverage
slices.description: Add default hard-law categories from the OHDER spec and expose architect facts for them.
acceptanceCriteria: Default law pack includes ProjectionAuthority, SSoTIntegrity, Replayability, SecurityBoundary, LayerIsolation, EventOnlySync, and DurabilityIntegrity.
Hard-law violations block unless exempted.
Existing exemption behavior remains deterministic.

slices.title: Map OHDER analyzer findings to laws
slices.description: Convert analyzer results into law-pack facts so strict mode can enforce architectural findings.
acceptanceCriteria: Cross-layer findings can produce layer isolation violations.
Direct governed-state writes can produce projection authority violations.
Durability and complexity findings map to governance facts.
Fast mode remains advisory for soft findings.

slices.title: Expand OHDER entropy dimensions
slices.description: Track SSoT, durability, complexity, duplication, observability, and refactor health trends in entropy history.
acceptanceCriteria: Metrics history includes expanded entropy dimensions.
Drift analytics computes trends for new dimensions.
Existing entropy and next-action behavior remains compatible.

slices.title: Add slice-close 16-step loop parity
slices.description: Make ask slice close record loop-state history and loop-step events equivalent to the autonomous loop where applicable.
acceptanceCriteria: Slice close writes loop-state history.
Slice close emits loop-step replay events.
Successful close records continue decision.
Blocked close records block decision.

slices.title: Add OHDER requirement analyzer runtime
slices.description: Classify requirements before intent and slice planning so OHDER can reason about risk earlier.
acceptanceCriteria: Requirements classify as feature, bugfix, refactor, docs, governance, release, security-sensitive, or durability-sensitive.
IntentSelected includes requirement analysis.
Slice metadata includes requirement class and risk flags.

slices.title: Enforce governed Codex session coverage
slices.description: Require governed launch evidence or explicit interactive checkpoint evidence before closing slices with code changes.
acceptanceCriteria: ASK distinguishes governed launch work from interactive work.
Interactive work needs explicit checkpoint evidence before close.
Existing hooks remain non-forging and fail-closed.

slices.title: Enforce OHDER refactor outcome validation
slices.description: Measure before/after refactor outcomes and require improvement or explicit justification.
acceptanceCriteria: Refactor tasks include before/after outcome evidence.
Worsening refactor outcomes are policy-governed.
Refactor mode can block unjustified entropy regression.

slices.title: Standardize architectural replay events
slices.description: Emit CodeWritten, TestPassed, TestFailed, ArchitectureScoreCalculated, and GovernanceGateBlocked events.
acceptanceCriteria: New replay events appear in ledger.
Existing projections remain compatible.
Replay proof still passes.

slices.title: Add OHDER security boundary analyzer
slices.description: Detect security-sensitive changes and feed risk into architect status, scoring, and strict-mode law enforcement.
acceptanceCriteria: Architect status includes securityAnalysis.
Security findings affect architecture score.
Strict mode can block security boundary violations.

slices.title: Expose OHDER runtime mode in CLI output
slices.description: Show current OHDER mode in architect status, governance status, governance explain, and project-state output.
acceptanceCriteria: Operators can see the current OHDER mode.
Governance explanation includes mode-specific behavior.
Docs explain when to use fast, strict, or refactor mode.

slices.title: Document future OHDER runtime evolution boundaries
slices.description: Separate implemented OHDER capabilities from IDEA-aware runtime, architectural councils, and autonomous entropy reduction plans.
acceptanceCriteria: Docs label current, partial, planned, and future runtime capabilities.
Future features have explicit implementation prerequisites.
Operator docs remain actionable.
